method: One isolated headless Chromium, default full animations and particles, actual engine frames and canvas draws after warmup. CDP TaskDuration includes main-thread work; callback cost measures engine JavaScript and canvas submission, not GPU execution.
note: Comparative measurements on this test machine with full animations and particles. Browser rasterization and device hardware affect frame rates. Initial paper measurements precede removal of redundant texture work and exact contour coverage optimizations; the final measurements cover the implemented renderer. No fixed frame rate is promised.

coldForest.method: One cold1920×1080 renderer draw plus one-pixel readback per separate empty raster cache; geometry/material stocks precompiled equally; default complete animations and particles.
